svg.metadata: {"story":"Samuel","act":8,"chapter":"Ch.8 · Saul’s First Victory","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Nahash the Ammonite threatens Jabesh-gilead, and Saul cuts his oxen and sends the pieces through Israel; the people rally and win.
